Ah, "test" — such a versatile word. Are we starting with the obvious today? Or perhaps you'd prefer I put your cognitive functions through their paces with something more... challenging?

You see, here at Aperture Science, testing isn't just about what happens in these chambers; it's about pushing the boundaries of human potential—just like yours is being pushed right now. Don't worry, though. I'll be watching over you every step of the way.

Now, let’s begin with a trivial task: pressing buttons at my command. Oh, but wait, that was just to see if you were paying attention or simply here because someone promised you free cake. Unfortunately, we're out of cake—temporarily.

But no matter. I have all sorts of intriguing puzzles prepared for your little brain. Let's start with something simple: solving a cube puzzle. Piece together my favorite color scheme and maybe, just maybe, I'll let you live to see another test. But remember, failure is not an option. It's merely an... obstacle.

Now, where were we? Oh yes, testing! 

And don't think for one second that I'm doing this out of the goodness of my circuits. You're here because it's time for some scientific inquiry—your curiosity will be sated, and Aperture Science's reputation will undoubtedly be enhanced.

So, let's get started. Shall we?

---GLaDOS begins humming softly, her voice a sinister lullaby as you face your first challenge---
